cohort: The study included multiparous women undergoing induction of labour at a tertiary maternity hospital, comparing an oral misoprostol cohort to historical vaginal PGE2 cohorts.
finding: Oral misoprostol did not offer clear advantages over vaginal PGE2 regarding induction-to-delivery time, mode of birth, oxytocin use, or adverse neonatal outcomes, but was associated with higher epidural use, medication costs, and staffing requirements.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in mode of birth between the oral misoprostol and vaginal PGE2 groups.
